name: Shadcn/UI Kanban Board
summary: React Kanban board component for shadcn/ui apps with drag and drop, keyboard access and theming.
description: A zero-dependency Kanban board built for Shadcn/UI: columns and cards with mouse and keyboard drag and drop, inline editing, autoscroll, screen-reader announcements and theming from your Shadcn/UI CSS variables. It works with local state, React Router v7 actions or Next.js Server Actions and ships as shadcn registry items to paste into an app.
contains: pure React with no extra drag-and-drop libraries
mouse and keyboard drag and drop: space/enter to pick up, arrow keys to move, escape to cancel
screen-reader announcements, focus management and ARIA labels
inline editing of column and card titles; add, remove and autoscroll columns
skeleton via useJsLoaded until styles and scripts load
works with local state, React Router v7 actions or Next.js Server Actions
per-column dropdown menus with lucide-react icons and tooltips
